about: What each step of a release build does, in plain words, for the page 'Patch and release'. The key is the name the run gives the step. The numbers beside a text come from the run; none is typed here. 'short' is the name on the step's button.

provider build.title: BAFU's release, as it is
provider build.text: BAFU's files are downloaded and checked against a known checksum. Nothing in them is changed. A Brightway database is built from them and checked. Every later step is measured against it.

patched build.title: Import fixes and community patches
patched build.text: First the import fixes: preparations that every reader of the files needs. Then the community patches change the data, one after the other. A second database is built from the result and labelled Modified Data.

written files.title: The files that were written
written files.text: Every patched file is read again. It must be valid ecoSpold, and it must be the file the run says it wrote.

patch run.title: What each patch found
patch run.text: Each patch must still find the data it was written for. A patch that changes nothing stops the run. One that changes less than in the release before is marked for a person to look at.

comparison.title: The two databases, compared
comparison.text: Every exchange of BAFU's release is compared with the patched one, and every score under each impact method. Each difference must be explained by an import fix or a patch. A difference that nothing explains stops the run.

exports.title: Files for LCA tools
exports.text: The patched release is written as files for Brightway, openLCA, ILCD and SimaPro. Each carries BAFU's credit, the label Modified Data and the list of changes. Each is read back and compared with the database.

release.title: From a run to a published copy
release.text: Every run ends here unless someone asks for its result to be published. A maintainer asks by pushing a tag. The run is then repeated for that tag and its manifest is published, and no file of the data.

contribution build.title: A contribution, built beside the patched release
contribution build.text: A contribution that changes the inventory is built as a database of its own, beside the patched release, and checked in the same way. It keeps its own name.

contribution comparison.title: The contribution, compared
contribution comparison.text: The contribution's database is compared with the patched release. Each difference must be one the contribution declares.

contribution exports.title: Files of the contribution
contribution exports.text: The contribution's database is written as files for LCA tools, and each file is read back.

other.title: A step of the run
other.text: The run recorded this step. This page has no description of it yet.
